test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Indian Constitution Act provides for the minimization of inequalities in income, property, facilities and opportunities in the Directive Principles of State Policy?
solution:
The Correct answer is__** **____**44th Constitutional Amendment 1978**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **44th Amendment Act** was enacted to reverse many provisions of the 42nd Amendment introduced during the Emergency.
 
• The **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act 1976** is often called the “**Mini Constitution**” due to the large number of changes it introduced in the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• This amendment made significant changes to the **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSPs)**, particularly by inserting new directives under **Article 39** of the Constitution.
 
• It added a directive for the State to secure the **minimization of inequalities in income, property, facilities, and opportunities** among citizens.
 
• The amendment emphasized **social, economic, and political justice**, aligning with the goals of a **welfare state**.
 
• It also added provisions related to the protection and improvement of the **environment**, safeguarding of **forests** and **wildlife**, and promotion of **equal justice**.
 
• The **42nd Amendment** was passed during the period of **Emergency (1975–1977)** under the leadership of then **Prime Minister Indira Gandhi**.
 
• Through this amendment, the words **“Socialist”** and **“Secular”** were also inserted into the **Preamble** of the Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **97th Constitutional Amendment 2011**__

 __
 
• The **97th Amendment Act** dealt with matters related to **co-operative societies**.
 
• It gave constitutional status and protection to **co-operatives** by inserting **Part IXB** in the Constitution.
 
• The amendment also added the words **“co-operative societies”** in **Article 19(1)(c)** and inserted **Article 43B** as part of DPSPs.
 
 

 
• **86th Constitutional Amendment 2002**__

 __
 
• The **86th Amendment Act** made **free and compulsory education** a **Fundamental Right** for children aged **6 to 14 years**.
 
• It inserted **Article 21A** into the Constitution and amended **Article 45** and **Article 51A**.
 
• This was a crucial step in achieving **universal elementary education** in India.
 
 
 
• **44th Constitutional Amendment 1978**__
 
 
• It restored the power of **judicial review** and strengthened the position of **Fundamental Rights**.
 
• It also safeguarded **Article 352** by making the proclamation of **Emergency** more difficult.
